name: suno
description: Create music and work with songs in your Suno library using the official Suno MCP server.

interface.shortDescription: Create music and work with your Suno library through conversation.
interface.longDescription: Connect your Suno account to create songs from your ideas and work with music in your library. Describe a mood, style, or lyrics, or ask your agent to help extend or cover a song using the tools available to your account. Music creation uses your Suno credits.
defaultPrompt: Create an upbeat instrumental track for my video.
Help me extend a song in my Suno library.
Turn my voice memo into a folk song while keeping the melody.
